title: FishingPointBattle
description: Competitive fishing minigame with combo system, special items, and strategic gameplay
body:
# 🎣 FishingPointBattle - Competitive Fishing Minigame

## 🌟 Overview

FishingPointBattle brings competitive fishing to Minecraft! Players compete to catch the most valuable fish within a time limit while using special items and building combos for maximum points.

## 🎮 Core Features

### Competitive Gameplay
- Time-based fishing competitions
- Point-based scoring system
- Automatic equipment distribution
- Area-restricted gameplay
- Sign-based join system

### Combo System
Build combos for multipliers:
- **3 Combo**: 1.2x points
- **5 Combo**: 1.5x points
- **7 Combo**: 1.8x points
- **10 Combo**: 2.0x points

### Golden Time
- Random 30-second bonus periods
- 2x points for all catches
- Strategic timing opportunities

## 🎯 7 Special Items

| Item | Effect | Duration |
|------|--------|----------|
| **Ink Bomb** | Blinds opponents | 3 seconds |
| **Freeze Ball** | Freezes players | 2 seconds |
| **Line Cutter** | Cuts fishing lines | Instant |
| **Lucky Bait** | Guaranteed rare | Next catch |
| **Speed Bait** | Luck II effect | 30 seconds |
| **Trap Float** | Area trap | 60 seconds |
| **Fish Beacon** | 1.3x point zone | 45 seconds |

## 📊 Point System

### Basic Fish
- Cod: 1 point
- Salmon: 2 points
- Pufferfish: 3 points
- Tropical Fish: 5 points

### Rare Catches
- Heart of the Sea: 15 points
- Enchanted Book: 15 points

## 🏆 Rewards
- **1st Place**: 3 Emeralds
- **2nd Place**: 2 Emeralds
- **3rd Place**: 1 Emerald

## 📋 Commands

- `/fpb help` - Show commands
- `/fpb setup` - Setup wizard
- `/fpb start [time]` - Start game
- `/fpb stop` - Stop game
- `/fpb reload` - Reload config
- `/fpb status` - Game status

## ⚙️ Configuration

Fully customizable:
- Game duration
- Point values
- Item drop rates
- Combo multipliers
- Reward items
- Special item effects

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Install the plugin
2. Run `/fpb setup` wizard
3. Set all required locations
4. Create join signs
5. Start playing!

## 📦 Requirements

- Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- Java 21+
- Fishing area with water
